reason: I feed four cats at home plus the strays behind my house, so I buy the big sacks of dry food and stretch it. RM 2.80 for one small 85g pouch is one meal for one cat, and RM 19.90 for 1kg of dry is about double what I pay per kilo now. I would follow the page, take the free pack and walk on.
objection: The cost per meal is too high for the number of cats I feed, and after 31 December I can only get it by messaging a Facebook page, with no idea about delivery cost or whether they will still be around.
would_change_my_mind: A big sack of dry food (7kg or more) at around RM 8 a kilo or less, that I can keep buying from a shop in Miri after the event.
